title: Carne Asada Burrito
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired burrito filled with grilled steak, sautéed onions, bell peppers, and warm tortillas.

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.notes: Marinate steak in lime juice and spices

ingredients.name: Mexican Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Add flavor to steak and vegetables

instructions: 1. Marinate steak in lime juice and Mexican seasoning for at least 30 minutes.
2. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
3. Meanwhile, sauté sliced onions and bell peppers in a pan until tender.
4. Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
5. Assemble burrito by placing grilled steak, sautéed onions and bell peppers, and shredded cheese (if using) onto a warmed tortilla.
6. Fold bottom edge of tortilla up over filling, then fold in sides and roll burrito up tightly.
8. Optional: Use a jerkily torn tortilla as a burrito wrap for a unique twist.
